svg.title: The Claude Code harness
svg.desc: Flow of one workflow task. A brief goes to an implementer, a Haiku seat verifies the head, and an Opus critic, a Sonnet verifier and a Sonnet gate review in parallel, then findings route to a fixer, a studio stop for taste calls, a deferred minors ledger, a parked state, or completion.

text.tspan: Haiku reads git, the only trusted head
one seat up per surviving finding
